theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_pst_patch_tangent_transfer
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (D : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (χ : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid P) (c : ℕ → Euclid n) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ), MeasurableSet S → μHE[n] S ≠ ∞ → (∀ k, IsOpen (D k)) → (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (χ k) (D k)) → (∀ k, closedBall (c k) (ρ k) ⊆ D k) → (∀ k, InjOn (χ k) (closedBall (c k) (ρ k))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict S), ∀ k, ∀ z ∈ ball (c k) (ρ k), χ k z = x → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (χ k '' closedBall (c k) (ρ k)) x Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n S x Q
